title: Uxbridge Trails Challenge 10K & Family 5K
summary: Run or hike through the Trail Capital of Canada with chip-timed 10K, relaxed 5K and kids' mud dash plus post-race local roastery coffee and live music.
description: Choose the technical 10K single-track loop or the stroller-friendly 5K along gravel paths. Participants receive reusable bibs, finish-line snacks from local farms, and a post-race wellness village featuring physio taping, yoga stretch tents and live folk music. Complimentary bike parking; limited vehicle parking on-site.
priceNote: Early-bird pricing through August 1; family relay add-on available.
